info.name: Feldera Pipeline CRUD API
info.description:
With Feldera, users create data pipelines out of SQL programs.

Contact Support:
 Name: Feldera Team
 Email: dev@feldera.com

query.description:
The `selector` parameter limits which fields are returned for a pipeline.
Limiting which fields is particularly handy for instance when frequently
monitoring over low bandwidth connections while being only interested
in pipeline status.

request.description:
Retrieve a pipeline.
Configure which fields are included using the `selector` query parameter.

response.name: Pipeline retrieved successfully
